documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, highlighting strong 85% year-on-year growth in its Healthcare segment, which became its largest business segment. Management noted challenges from geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions affecting raw material and freight costs, but remains confident about capacity expansions, including pen injector lines and new projects in consumer electronics and industrial segments. The company appointed dedicated business development heads for Europe and North America and expects continued momentum through FY27. Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27 in an investor presentation, showing a 14% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue to Rs. 280.7 crores.

guidance.claim: The company targets a combined capacity of around 40 million to 42 million pens from the two new lines by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: See, what our target is that by the end of the year, both lines should be able to produce at 65 to 67 parts per minute effectively, which gives us a combined capacity of both these 2 new lines of around 40 million to 42 million pens combined.

guidance.claim: The company targets 35 million to 40 million pens from the new capacity to be in supply by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: By FY28, I think what we're targeting is 35 million to 40 million pens from that capacity should more or less be in supply by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: The global operating environment remained challenging due to geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia impacting supply chains and commodity markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The global operating environment remained challenging in the quarter with continued uncertainty arising from the geopolitical situation in West Asia and its wider impact on supply chain as well as commodity markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The Consumer segment reported softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and the United States.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance reflected softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and United States, our largest export markets for the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and USA.
demand_outlook.quote: Weaker Market Demand for Home Furnishings across Europe & USA

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that improved traction in the healthcare segment was the key driver for overall business growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Improved traction in the healthcare segment has been the key driver for the overall growth of the business

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment degrew in Q4 '26 due to weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment unfortunately de-grew in Q4 '26, primarily reflecting weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S., our 2 largest export markets for this vertical.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers in Canada are asking for more product following the two launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Given only 2 launches in Canada, we are asked for more product.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer business experienced order cancellations from the Middle East in Q4 due to the war happening there.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q4, we also saw some cancellation of orders or something from Middle East because of the war happening there.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
capex_expansion.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: For Semiconductor Trays, the company is looking at investing about 5 crores in its existing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Semiconductor Trays, I think we have mentioned that we are looking at investing about INR5 crores in our existing facility, which would meet initial requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: For Consumer Electronics, the investment in the plant down south will be between 80 crores to 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On Consumer Electronics, again, we have said that once we set up a plant down south, we would be looking at an investment of somewhere between INR80 crores to INR100 crores in that facility.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at 83 crores with an EBITDA margin improvement of 120 bps to 29.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR83 crores from INR70 crores, reflecting a growth of 18%, while EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps to 29.7%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 17.1%, representing an expansion of 40 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 17.1%, an expansion of 40 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Volatility in key raw material prices, particularly polymers, logistics disruptions, and elevated freight costs occurred during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: This led to volatility in key raw material prices, particularly polymers alongside logistic disruptions, container availability constraints and elevated freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY '26 EBITDA margin stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps over Q4 FY '25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps Q4 FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY '26 EBITDA margins stood at 29.0%, an increase of 630 bps over FY '25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 29.0%, an increase of 630 bps over FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY '26 PAT margin stood at 17.2%, an increase of 540 bps over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin stood at 17.2%, an increase of 540 bps over FY25.

orders_capacity.claim: Healthcare segment revenue grew 85% year-on-year to 142 crores, contributing approximately 51% of consolidated revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Segment revenue grew 85% year-on-year to INR142 crores, contributing approximately 51% of consolidated revenue and becoming our largest business segment for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26, reflecting a gradual improvement in capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company received orders for injector pen supplies following regulatory approvals for Semaglutide in Canada and Brazil.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we received orders for injector pen supplies following regulatory approvals secured for the sale of Semaglutide in Canada, Brazil by our pharmaceutical partners.

orders_capacity.claim: The Consumer segment reported revenue of 116 crores, accounting for around 41% of consolidated revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: The Consumer segment reported revenue of INR116 crores during the quarter, accounting for around 41% of consolidated revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The Industrial segment revenue increased 25% year-on-year to 23 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The Industrial segment maintained its healthy growth trajectory with revenue increasing 25% year-on-year to INR23 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a new project from an Automotive customer.
Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY '26 compared to 42.2% last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY '26 compared to 42.2% last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The 25 million capacity installed in March is currently running at roughly 45% operational efficiency.
orders_capacity.quote: The 25 million capacity that we installed in March is currently running at roughly 45% utilization, and not utilization, at operational efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores as an annual affair to maintain financial flexibility.
capital_allocation.quote: Reflecting the confidence in Shaily's next phase of growth and the multiple new opportunities ahead of us, the Board of Directors have approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores. I would like to clarify that this is intended to be an annual affair.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situation in West Asia caused uncertainty and impacted supply chains and commodity markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global operating environment remained challenging in the quarter with continued uncertainty arising from the geopolitical situation in West Asia and its wider impact on supply chain as well as commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty across global trade corridors, impacting freight movement, supply chain, and input cost dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter has witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty, particularly due to ongoing tensions across global trade corridors, which impacted freight movement, supply chain and input cost dynamics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material price inflation and selective logistical disruptions occurred across certain export routes for the plastics and polymer industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the plastics and polymer industry, this translated into raw material price inflation and selective logistical disruptions across certain export routes.

management_commitments.claim: The additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects gross margin to come back to normalized level by quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: We expect that the gross margin would come back to normalized level by quarter 3.

management_commitments.claim: The Abu Dhabi plant is supposed to start selling by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is supposed to start selling by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The Consumer segment business would maintain at a level which was done in FY26 during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: So we will maintain, at a level which we did in FY26.

management_commitments.claim: The emergency use auto-injector program will be brought to a closure by the end of '27.
management_commitments.quote: On the emergency use auto-injector, it's a program that we've been working on for roughly 18 months, and we will bring it to a closure by the end of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies to the consumer electronics customer commenced during Q4 FY '26.
management_commitments.quote: I'm pleased to share that we successfully commenced commercial supplies to our consumer electronics customer during Q4 FY '26.

management_commitments.claim: Additional 25 million capacity for Semaglutide will come in by July, August.
management_commitments.quote: The additional 25 million that will come in by July, August is purely for Semaglutide, which will be again used for the global markets where the product is launched.

management_commitments.claim: Commercialization of the eye-applicator is factored into the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And we have factored the commercialization of the eye-applicator in the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
